method: Hands-on API calls from this session; see IMAGE_SOURCES.md for caveats. null = not measured.

sources.name: The Metropolitan Museum of Art Open Access
sources.licence: CC0 1.0 for images marked Open Access (isPublicDomain=true)
sources.attribution: Not required (credit requested). Must not use Met trademarks or imply endorsement.
sources.total_usable: ~490k OA images museum-wide (museum figure); 502,873 object records in API
sources.max_resolution: primaryImage 'original' JPG: median long edge ~2,670px (n=20, range 680-4,759); 30% >=3,508px; 0% reach A3@300dpi
sources.notes: Counts = subject-tag hits x sampled share(20/theme) that are PD with image. Search filters are order-sensitive (q must be last). Many Met Monets flag isPublicDomain=false with no image (e.g. 437106, 438004) - lender/donor restrictions. Good for A4; A3 only at ~200dpi.

sources.name: Smithsonian Open Access
sources.attribution: Not required. 'Smithsonian' name/logo are trademarks: no endorsement or use on products.
sources.api: https://api.si.edu/openaccess/api/v1.0/search ; bulk NDJSON on S3: https://smithsonian-open-access.s3-us-west-2.amazonaws.com/metadata/edan/{unit}/NN.txt ; images https://ids.si.edu/ids/download?id=...
sources.auth: API: free api.data.gov key. DEMO_KEY = 10 req/hour per IP and was already exhausted (HTTP 429) on this shared egress IP - unusable. S3 bulk metadata needs no key.
sources.total_usable: Art units counted: SAAM 13,005; Asian Art (FSG) 4,711; Cooper Hewitt ~54,700 (scaled from 1/8 sample); Air & Space 995 CC0 records with images. Museum-wide ~5M CC0 items, mostly specimens/archives.
sources.max_resolution: Hi-res JPEG/TIFF listed in metadata; median long edge SAAM 3,000, FSG 4,200, Cooper Hewitt 5,090, NASM 3,648
sources.notes: Theme counts are keyword matches (title/topics) across SAAM+FSG+Cooper Hewitt+NASM only; natural-history specimen photos (NMNH birds/insects/botany units, >2GB metadata each) excluded - they are photos of specimens, less suitable as art. Cooper Hewitt has lots of wallpaper/textile designs - good pattern prints.

sources.name: Rijksmuseum
sources.licence: CC0 1.0 / Public Domain Mark on public-domain works (rights on the DigitalObject/VisualItem)
sources.api: https://data.rijksmuseum.nl/search/collection?imageAvailable=true&type=..&title=..&description=..&creator=.. (Linked Art JSON-LD; follow shows -> digitally_shown_by -> access_point IIIF on iiif.micr.io)
sources.auth: none (new Data Services API; old key-based API retired)
sources.total_usable: With image: prints 386,845; drawings 48,553; paintings 4,876; photographs 121,592; maps 5,288; posters 5,024
sources.max_resolution: IIIF full/max; sample Hokusai print 3,933x4,394 (maxArea 17.5MP) - ~A3 at 250dpi
sources.notes: Theme counts are Dutch keyword matches (vogel, haas, vos, paard, kat, hond, koe, insect, vis, vlinder, bloem, landschap) and include some noise ('vos'/'kat' also names). 'posters' type includes 20th-century works still in copyright - check the CC0 flag per image. 3 hops per object to reach the image URL.

sources.name: Art Institute of Chicago
sources.attribution: Not required; do not use AIC name/marks or imply endorsement
sources.api: https://api.artic.edu/api/v1/artworks/search (Elasticsearch DSL via POST, filter is_public_domain) ; images: https://www.artic.edu/iiif/2/{image_id}/full/{w},/0/default.jpg
sources.auth: none; send AIC-User-Agent header - IIIF behind Cloudflare returns 403 challenge to default curl UA, and 'full'/'max' size keywords returned 403 - request an explicit width
sources.max_resolution: thumbnail.width/height = true master size; median long edge 3,000px, 39% >=4,961 (up to 19,601); IIIF served at full size (checked 10,490px)
sources.notes: Best Hiroshige source (1,678). Monet paintings (46) are here, unlike the Met. Counts from multi_match on title/subject/term/classification with operator=and.

sources.name: Cleveland Museum of Art Open Access
sources.attribution: Not required; citing CMA does not imply endorsement; trademarks need approval
sources.max_resolution: 3 renditions: web, print JPG (max 3,400px), full TIFF (median 5,247px, 59% >=4,961, max 25,609). Full TIFF ~70MB each.
sources.notes: Best A3@300dpi hit-rate of the museum APIs. 'q' search is fuzzy - butterflies/birds include decorative arts; filter by type=Print/Painting/Drawing. Use artists= not q= for painter counts (q='Gogh' returned 570 noisy hits vs 5 real).

sources.name: National Gallery of Art (Washington) Open Data
sources.auth: none (github.com web UI blocked by this proxy; raw.githubusercontent.com works)
sources.total_usable: 63,858 objects with an open-access primary image
sources.max_resolution: Masters median 4,529px long edge (28% >=4,961) but IIIF silently caps delivery at 4,096px (Monet 'Morning Haze' 5,980 wide -> 4,096 delivered)
sources.notes: Turner count includes other Turners (e.g. engravers); 'monet' regex also hit 'Antonello della Moneta' (2) - corrected. Index of American Design watercolours = good folk-art animals.

sources.name: Yale Center for British Art
sources.licence: CC0 1.0 on public-domain object IIIF manifests (manifest 'rights'); metadata CC0
sources.attribution: Not required; manifest warns 'copyright or other restrictions may apply' - check rights per object
sources.api: IIIF manifests https://manifests.collections.yale.edu/ycba/obj/{id} ; search via LUX API https://lux.collections.yale.edu/api/search/item (send browser UA)
sources.auth: none; collections.britishart.yale.edu web search returns 403 to scripts
sources.total_usable: 135,607 YCBA items in LUX (all rights; most pre-1900 British art is PD)
sources.notes: Best Turner/Constable/British sporting-art (horses, hounds, foxes) source. Counts are LUX full-text estimates, not rights-filtered.

sources.name: Library of Congress (Prints & Photographs, Geography & Map)
sources.licence: Mostly public domain / 'No known restrictions on publication' - an advisory, not a licence; many items say 'Rights status not evaluated'
sources.attribution: Not required (courtesy credit 'Library of Congress, Prints & Photographs Division' requested)
sources.api: https://www.loc.gov/{photos,maps,collections/...}/?fo=json ; legacy https://www.loc.gov/pictures/search/?co=pos&fo=json ; item JSON has rights_advisory and master TIFF
sources.total_usable: WPA posters 947 (all 'no known restrictions'); Posters collection 5,921 online (travel 455, railroad 101); maps online 57,819 (46,259 dated pre-1927); Japanese fine prints 2,788
sources.max_resolution: Master TIFFs: WPA Zion poster 4,246x5,742 (73MB) - A3@300dpi OK
sources.notes: Animal/landscape counts are mostly PHOTOGRAPHS (all eras). Filter rights_advisory == 'No known restrictions on publication.' Canadian Pacific/foreign travel posters in 'pos' are 'Rights status not evaluated' - may be in copyright in UK.

sources.name: Biodiversity Heritage Library
sources.licence: Public domain for pre-1927 scans (BHL marks most items 'Public domain. The BHL considers that this work is no longer under copyright protection'); some items CC BY-NC - check per item
sources.api: BHL API v3 (free key) ; page images https://www.biodiversitylibrary.org/pageimage/{pageID} -> bhl-open-data S3 webp ; archive.org mirror https://archive.org/download/{id}/page/n{N}.jpg ; Flickr 'biodivlibrary' (Flickr API key needed)
sources.auth: BHL/Flickr API: free keys; archive.org none
sources.total_usable: Flickr account: 319,661 curated plate images; archive.org 'biodiversity' collection 286,261 volumes. Theme numbers here are VOLUMES (pre-1927) not plates.
sources.max_resolution: archive.org page JPGs ~1,850x3,185; BHL S3 webp ~2,900x3,900 - A4 at ~250dpi, A3 only via upscaling
sources.notes: Richest source for natural-history plates (Curtis's Botanical Magazine, Gould, Audubon-era works). Needs cropping/cleanup: page borders, foxing, scanner fingers (visible in sample).

sources.name: NYPL Digital Collections
sources.licence: Public domain items flagged 'No known US copyright restrictions' (rights=pd); free reuse
sources.auth: free API token required (401 without); website blocks scripts (Incapsula)
sources.max_resolution: up to ~2,560px 'original' download typical; TIFF on request
sources.notes: Only one count obtained before bot-blocking (cats: 442 PD). Strong for botanical/ornithological plates, menus, Japanese prints.

sources.name: Wikimedia Commons
sources.licence: Per file. PD-Art / PD-old-100 files are public domain in source country; Commons PD-Art policy asserts faithful 2D reproductions get no new copyright
sources.attribution: Not legally required for PD; required for CC-BY/BY-SA files
sources.auth: none; descriptive User-Agent required; heavy 429 rate-limiting from shared IPs; thumbnails only at standard widths (2000px returned 400, 1920px OK)
sources.max_resolution: Up to gigapixel (Starry Night Google Art Project 44,567x35,291)
sources.notes: Full-text search: counts are noisy upper bounds ('cat'/'map' matched 1M+/2M+ so omitted). Maps = intitle:map + PD-old-100. Great for famous paintings at huge resolution, but provenance of scans (e.g. Google Art Project from museums that claim rights) needs care; licence tags are user-applied.

sources.name: Openverse
sources.auth: anonymous works but result_count capped at 240; register (free OAuth) for more
sources.notes: Use for discovery only; download originals from the source.

sources.name: Paris Musées Collections
sources.auth: free token required (anonymous GraphQL returns HTML)
sources.notes: Keyword counts not obtainable anonymously. Strong on Paris views, Carnavalet posters/prints, Petit Palais paintings.

sources.name: David Rumsey Map Collection
sources.total_usable: 0 for commercial use without a paid licence from Stanford/Rumsey
sources.notes: NonCommercial licence - NOT usable for print-on-demand. Use LoC maps, BHL/Wikimedia PD maps or NLS instead.

sources.name: NASA Image and Video Library
sources.licence: NASA material generally not copyrighted (US federal works); NASA Media Usage Guidelines
sources.attribution: 'Credit: NASA' requested; third-party credits (ESA/CSA/STScI/JPL-Caltech) must be checked
sources.total_usable: nebula 316, galaxy 1,741, planet 7,623, Hubble 4,789, JWST 736, Moon 20,109, Earth 41,055
sources.max_resolution: 'orig' varies: Webb Carina only 2,000px in library (full 14k TIFF on webbtelescope.org / esawebb.org, the latter CC BY 4.0)
sources.notes: Cannot use NASA insignia/logo or imply endorsement; identifiable astronauts - no commercial endorsement use. ESA images are CC BY-SA/BY 4.0 - attribution required.

sources.name: Natural Earth
sources.total_usable: All countries (258 admin-0 units at 10m) + states, rivers, lakes, coastlines
sources.notes: Ideal for generated country-outline / minimalist map prints.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap
sources.attribution: On physical merchandise: attribution on packaging, at point of sale (listing) and where possible on the item itself, readable, including the printed URL 'openstreetmap.org/copyright' (e.g. '© OpenStreetMap contributors, openstreetmap.org/copyright')
sources.api: Overpass API / Geofabrik extracts; render yourself
sources.notes: Exemption: fewer than 100 features or <10,000 m2 area need no attribution. Don't use osm.org tiles (tile usage policy) - render your own.

sources.name: Ordnance Survey OpenData
sources.attribution: 'Contains OS data © Crown copyright and database right [year]'
sources.api: https://api.os.uk/downloads/v1/products (no key; 24 products incl. OpenZoomstack, Terrain50, OpenRivers, OpenRoads, BoundaryLine, VectorMapDistrict, MiniScale)
sources.notes: Good for UK town/street/contour prints. Must not imply OS endorsement or use OS logo.
